Mission Local reported that paid lawn reservations at Dolores Park were discontinued in 2016. The story says the city changed its reservation policy to limit reservations to picnic tables; it also notes that permit fees help offset cleanup costs. It doesn’t establish the current rules for every kind of large picnic, so check with Rec & Park before making plans.

The story does not include a correction.
